name: Pizzaïolo-Ninja
storyline:
Your uncle is being harassed by the henchmen of Bartony, a tyrant of industrial pizza who wants to buy his pizzeria and replace it with a vending machine dispensing… pineapple pizza (yes, that’s a crime).
You play as Tony Tribbiani, an Italian guy that's half-pizzaïolo, half-ninja (and 100% pissed off).
Your mission?
Climb to the top of Bartony Tower, put an end to his reign of terror, and save pizza’s honor before it’s tainted by… pineapple.
Your superpower?
You’re a ninja—on top of legendary flexibility, you’ve got killer agility, a must-have for scaling the tower and dodging the many traps in your way! Or for falling… but in style.
Ready to fall… but not to give up? Let’s go!
summary: Pizzaïolo-Ninja is a 'Die & Retry' platformer with 100 levels, a global speedrun leaderboard, a Streamer Mode to play with your Twitch chat.
